data.restoreHint: Review before continuing. This Keysmith Switch backup replaces the existing library and settings.
data.restoreScope: The prompt library, version history, activation records, and settings may be replaced. The archive is verified before any current data is changed.

data.importLegacyScope: Existing data stays in place. Imported prompts may be added as new library entries.
data.clearAllHint: Deletes the prompt library, history, backups, and logs. Irreversible. A normal uninstall keeps these files.
data.clearSecond: I have read the scope and confirm this cannot be undone
data.nothingImported: No prompts were available to import
